description: This file is a JSON Schema and API definition for managing DHCPv4 Server Pools, including endpoints for adding, listing, retrieving, setting, and deleting DHCPv4 pools, along with detailed response schemas and data models.

methods.name: Services.Local.DHCP.Server.v4.Pools.Add
methods.description: Adds a new DHCPv4 Server Pool.

methods.name: Services.Local.DHCP.Server.v4.Pools.List
methods.description: Retrieves a list of DHCPv4 Server Pools.

methods.name: Services.Local.DHCP.Server.v4.Pools.{PoolId}.Get
methods.description: Retrieves the status and configuration of a specific DHCPv4 Server Pool identified by PoolId.

methods.name: Services.Local.DHCP.Server.v4.Pools.{PoolId}.Set
methods.description: Modifies the specified DHCPv4 Server Pool's status and configuration.

methods.name: Services.Local.DHCP.Server.v4.Pools.{PoolId}.Delete
methods.description: Deletes the specified DHCPv4 Server Pool identified by PoolId.
